translation: Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
translation: And whoever puts their trust in Allah, then He will suffice them.
So remember Me, and I will remember you.
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
Indeed, it is in the remembrance of Allah that hearts find peace.
Cleanliness is half of faith.
The best among you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.

arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
translation: Whoever travels a path in search of knowledge, Allah will make easy for them a path to Paradise.

arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
translation: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.

arabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
translation: Your smile for your brother is a charity.
My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.

arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
translation: My Lord, expand my chest and ease my task for me.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You, and worship You properly.
Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.

arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
translation: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
I seek forgiveness from Allah.
All praise is due to Allah.
Allah is the Greatest.
Start and end your day with the remembrance of Allah. It brings peace to the heart and blessings to your time.
Pray your five daily prayers on time. They are the pillar of Islam and a direct connection to Allah.
Give charity, even if it's small. Every good deed counts, and charity purifies your wealth.
Be patient in difficulty. Allah rewards those who remain steadfast through trials.
Read at least one ayah of the Qur'an daily. Even a small amount of recitation brings immense reward.
And be patient, for your patience is only through Allah.

arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
translation: And when My servants ask you about Me, indeed I am near.
Supplication is the essence of worship.
Friday is a blessed day. Increase your prayers and send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ.
Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
